authority: RESEARCH_PLAN.md P5/P7 and minimum success conditions; protocol remains byte-frozen.

current_preflight.plan: Direct stored-gzip ZIP build; actual-ZIP fresh case-by-case -S verification; cleanup only successful owned scratch case.

small_fixture_receipt.scope: Syntax and early incomplete inventory build gate only; not science or future ZIP/replay acceptance.

required_inventory.switch_stage_grid: 20,40,...,H; all declared members retained; no empty or duplicate groups

per_row_chain: exact logical key and frozen direction record/projection
full experiment fingerprint and canonical case/alias mapping
uniform comparator mean and variance; true nonlinear remainder; per-hypothesis events and guarded risk
current full/derived stdlib receipt and artifact hash binding
referenced PRIOR_CASE/PRIOR_STDLIB/rebinding transaction; all attempts/interruption/failure records

classification_rules.pass_and_target_not_met: Both require the complete canonical science payload and independent verifier; target-not-met is retained, not physical impossibility.
classification_rules.zero_direction: Exact KKT/rounded-direction degeneracy and physical instance replay; no numeric risk/covariance substitution, no full-experiment zero-information claim.
classification_rules.unresolved_failures: Every explicit physical/projection/mean/variance/execution failure keeps cause/history/available bytes; failure-inclusive archive may be explicitly authorized but never final scientific PASS.
classification_rules.aliases: Fingerprint protocol,T_fast_steps,moves,complete observations,readout,exact direction. Preserve all logical rows and replay each unique scientific experiment once; names or H alone are insufficient.

R1_bootstrap.strategy: Include the exact original ZIP and bootstrap it once inside the fresh validation root. Do not copy the entire active R1 extraction now.
R1_bootstrap.scope: Original fixed-case R1 verification is inherited, not silently promoted to new D2-a cases.

environment.independent_verification: 64-bit Python>=3.11; separate -S -B -X utf8 processes; no NumPy/SciPy import
environment.witness_parser_RAM: Original actual_direction.certify loads full per-case gzip JSON; disk streaming does not prove low-RAM operation.

disk_recipe.build: Stream selected original files directly into one new Zip64 archive; gzip witnesses and original ZIP use ZIP_STORED; no full staging copy.
disk_recipe.validate: Actual ZIP fresh shared bootstrap plus one canonical science case at a time, complete -S verifier, save new receipts/log/hash, then native PowerShell cleanup only that successful owned scratch case. Keep failed scratch; never delete original science.
disk_recipe.delivery: Optional validated immutable ZIP same-volume hardlink; target must not exist; no second physical ZIP or other-drive write.
disk_recipe.planning_model: Current science remains resident. Additional completion bytes + one archive + shared bootstrap + maxcase scratch + reserve. Actual final payload/free space must be recomputed before build.

future_final_freeze_schema.science_owner_pids: science/publisher and owned descendants; actual CIM absence checked at guarded build/replay

publication_artifacts.revision: explicit future current revision; not hardcodedR6/R7

future_final_freeze_schema.allow_failure_inclusive_archive: explicit if unresolved classified failures remain; no final science-ready then

current_recipe_validation_scope: Actual current small-metadata preflight plus syntax/incomplete400 guard fixture. Future archive-build and full replay branches not run or accepted.
precise_remaining_recipe_gate: Before any future final scientific-ready, connect outputs/d2a_full_grid_acceptance_v1.py to a bounded actual-ZIP metadata view/member-presence adapter. Its current is_file witness check assumes all case directories coexist, conflicting with successful per-case scratch cleanup. Do not fabricate empty witnesses or fall back to original worktree. The current future replay branch intentionally returns scientific_ready=false pending this gate.
publication_scope: Final source/PDF/compile-layout/review/figure bindings are explicit future inputs. V2R6 ZIP remains historical immutable; current paper revisions may advance without changing physics protocol.
